bio.text: Jason Murillo is the Republican and Conservative Party candidate for New York State Senate District 27 in the November 3, 2026 general election, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia says he was born in New York City and graduated from Seward Park High School, lists his career as politician and attorney, and notes he is also known as DJ Loud Mouth.

In a Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey he completed in 2024 for his 2025 New York City Council District 2 campaign, he described himself as a lifelong resident of the Lower East Side and East Village and said he is heard weekly on WPAT 930 AM radio.
